data.one_liner: Icon pack provider with multiple icon sets for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Super Icons bundles several popular icon packs and exposes each icon as a constant. It allows developers to use icons from Bootstrap, BoxIcons, Clarity, EvaIcons, HeroIcons, Iconsax, IonIcons, Lucide, MingCute, and PelaIcons directly in their widgets.
use_when: Need a wide variety of icons without adding many separate packages
Want quick access to multiple icon sets in a single dependency
Building UI prototypes that require diverse iconography
avoid_when: Only one icon set is required
Bundle size is a concern for small apps
weaknesses: Increases app size due to many icons
No support for custom icon fonts
No code generation or theming integration

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Font Awesome icons with a single package

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers Lucide icons with a smaller set
